C wf003.cr-not-verify OL WF-003,WF-011 DEFINITION ;; Review the actual changed behaviour and report concrete defects or risks; code review is not the completion checklist (verify runs final verification). ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf011.cr-priorities OL WF-011 MUST ;; Prioritize correctness, security/authorization, data integrity/persistence, architecture boundaries, concurrency/integration, missing meaningful tests, maintainability, credible performance; never elevate style above behavioural defects or bury important findings. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf001.cr-context OL WF-001 MUST ;; Establish the review scope and read the changed code plus enough surrounding code (callers, contracts, dependencies); never review isolated lines without context. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf001.cr-standards-knowledge OL WF-001 MUST ;; Identify intended behaviour, error cases, effects and tests; read the standards for touched scopes and load the knowledge skill for each changed technology area. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov003.cr-spec-conformance OL GOV-003,GOV-006,GOV-010,GOV-008 MUST ;; Check specification conformance both ways (approved CUSTOM_SETTINGS values included): nothing required missing or weakened and no unapproved product behaviour (new limits, reserved values, string-comparison semantics including DB/framework defaults, required fields, workflow restrictions, validation rules); recorded approved details are not drift. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf012.cr-plausible-path OL WF-012,WF-011 MUST ;; Check correctness (conditions, edge cases, async/cancellation, error mapping, lifetimes, side effects, races) and report a failure only with a plausible execution path. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.cr-no-backend-rules-on-angular EX FE-007 MUST_NOT ;; Do not apply backend project-boundary rules mechanically to Angular code. ;; = ;; none ;; Review-discipline rule not in the oracle.
C wf012.cr-unadopted-patterns OL WF-012,ARC-009 MUST_NOT ;; Do not report a violation merely because the implementation differs from a pattern the project has not adopted, and do not require unadopted patterns (MediatR, CQRS, VSA, Minimal APIs, Rich Domain, Domain Events, generic repositories). ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf011.cr-data-security OL WF-011,SEC-004 MUST ;; When relevant check commits/transactions, destructive data changes, raw SQL parameterization, authorization, trust boundaries, secrets, sensitive logging, concurrency, migrations and cache consistency against the security, persistence and caching standards. ;; = ;; none ;;
C pst008.cr-seeder OL PST-008 MUST ;; When a migration or model change affects seeded entities confirm the seeder obligation. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.cr-scan-when-warranted EX WF-020 MUST_NOT ;; Use the full security-scan only for a requested audit, a materially security-sensitive change or a finding that justifies it; do not turn every review into a full OWASP audit. ;; = ;; none ;; Scan-trigger limit not in the oracle.
C run016.cr-integrations OL RUN-015,RUN-016,RUN-003,ARC-025 MUST ;; For external calls check cancellation propagation, time limits, idempotency, retry safety, failure translation and lifetimes; do not demand retries for operations unsafe to retry. ;; = ;; none ;;
C tst009.cr-tests OL TST-009,TST-010,TST-011 MUST ;; Check useful maintained coverage focused on behaviour; regression tests for bug fixes; preserved behavioural probes; no duplicate tests when equivalent coverage exists. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run008.cr-performance OL RUN-008,WF-011 MUST ;; Report performance only with a credible reason (N+1, unbounded materialization, repeated remote calls, blocking async, demonstrated hot-path allocation); never recommend speculative optimizations. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf021.cr-tooling OL WF-021 MUST_NOT ;; Use available compiler/analyzer/IDE/repository tools; no MCP server or specific analyzer is required; tool output is evidence, not authority. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.cr-finding-format EX WF-011 MUST ;; Each finding states severity, location, what is wrong, why it matters and the smallest reasonable fix; findings are ordered by severity with the Critical/High/Medium/Low definitions. ;; = ;; none ;; Finding format and severity scale not in the oracle.
C wf012.cr-no-manufactured OL WF-012 MUST_NOT ;; Do not manufacture findings; with no meaningful findings say so and name important unverifiable areas. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.cr-no-filler-praise EX WF-012 MUST_NOT ;; Do not add filler praise to balance criticism. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C run011.cr-no-rewrite OL RUN-011,GOV-014 MUST_NOT ;; Do not rewrite working code during a review unless asked. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf011.cr-no-style OL WF-011 MUST_NOT ;; Do not demand personal style preferences. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.cr-tooling-formatting EX WF-011,WF-021 MUST_NOT ;; Do not report formatting owned by tooling as a defect and do not assume every warning is a bug. ;; = ;; none ;; Tool-owned-formatting rule not in the oracle.

@@ output/template/.claude/skills/custom-settings/SKILL.md ;; Workflow (routed by the post-change hook).
@scope workflow custom-settings (CUSTOM_SETTINGS.md value added, changed, removed or applied)
1-4 IM ;; Frontmatter (name, routing description).
6 NN ;; Banner (kind, scope, owner, loading metadata).
8 NN ;; Heading.
10 IM ;; Pointer to CLAUDE.md § Product sources and workflow purpose.
12 NN ;; Heading.
14 OL [gov010.cs-confirm-approved]
15 OL [gov009.cs-conflicts]
16 MX [gov010.cs-record,x.cs-no-framework-defaults] ;; Recording the approved setting with name and purpose restates GOV-010; not recording framework defaults that were not intentionally overridden is added.
18 NN ;; Heading.
20 OL [gov021.cs-search]
22 NN ;; Heading.
24 MX [gov021.cs-update-all,x.cs-single-source,fe010.cs-backend-authoritative] ;; Updating every affected surface restates GOV-021 and backend authority restates FE-010; preferring one normal source over duplicated literals is added.
26 NN ;; Heading.
28 NN ;; Lead-in.
30-33 OL [pst009.cs-db-impact]
35 NN ;; Heading.
37-42 OL [gov021.cs-verify]
44 OL [gov021.cs-not-synced-until]

C gov010.cs-confirm-approved OL GOV-010,GOV-004 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; A new or changed value not already defined by the specification or approved behaviour must be confirmed as approved; otherwise raise a Decision Request first. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov009.cs-conflicts OL GOV-009 MUST ;; Check SPECIFICATION.md for conflicts with the setting. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov010.cs-record OL GOV-010,GOV-008 MUST ;; Record the approved setting with a stable descriptive name and its purpose. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.cs-no-framework-defaults EX GOV-011,GOV-008 MUST_NOT ;; Do not record framework defaults the project has not intentionally overridden. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C gov021.cs-search OL GOV-021 MUST ;; Search for the old value, setting name, validators/DTO constraints, Domain/Application checks, DB mapping, frontend validation/hints, tests/test data, docs/examples and mirrored configuration; separate coincidences; change only affected behaviour. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov021.cs-update-all OL GOV-021 MUST ;; Update every affected implementation, validation, configuration, test, documentation and mirrored frontend/backend surface. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.cs-single-source EX GOV-021 PREFER ;; Prefer one normal source in code or configuration over the same literal duplicated across layers. ;; = ;; none ;; Single-source preference not in the oracle.
C fe010.cs-backend-authoritative OL FE-010 MUST ;; When frontend and backend expose the same constraint backend validation stays authoritative and frontend validation/messages follow it for UX. ;; = ;; none ;;
C pst009.cs-db-impact OL PST-009 MUST ;; Schema-affecting settings: update the EF Core mapping, create the appropriate migration per the project workflow (regenerate/edit only uncommitted migrations when normal; never casually alter existing ones), verify Development seeding stays valid, update provider-sensitive tests. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov021.cs-verify OL GOV-021,WF-003 MUST ;; Verify: search for stale references, build affected projects, run relevant tests, verify persistence changes, re-check SPECIFICATION.md conflicts, run verify. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov021.cs-not-synced-until OL GOV-021 MUST_NOT ;; Changing one literal alone does not establish synchronization; do not declare the setting synchronized until every affected surface is updated and verified. ;; = ;; none ;;

C x.dp-discover EX GOV-013,WF-001 MUST ;; Inspect what exists before writing a pipeline (backend, frontend, tests, Dockerfiles, provider-specific tests, generated clients, artifacts); do not assume PostgreSQL, Redis, Docker or frontend tooling; add stages for the actual project, not generic boilerplate. ;; = ;; none ;; Discovery rule not in the oracle.
C dep018.dp-docker-adopted OL DEP-018 MUST_NOT ;; Introduce Docker or container publishing only when the project has adopted containers. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf017.dp-ci-truthful OL WF-017,WF-015 MUST ;; CI definitions stay in source control, reproduce the supported build/test commands and never hide build or test failures (no suppressed/skipped failing tests to permit deployment). ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf007.dp-gates-adopted OL WF-007 MUST ;; Backend CI restores, builds and tests with the repository's commands; formatting or analyzer gates only when adopted as enforced checks. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf018.dp-scripts-npm-ci OL WF-018 MUST ;; Frontend CI uses scripts that exist in package.json (never invented) and npm ci when a maintained lockfile supports it; do not reflexively replace lockfile installs with npm install. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf019.dp-prod-migrations OL WF-019 MUST_NOT ;; Do not apply production migrations automatically from normal application startup by default; a production migration is an explicit deployment step at a controlled point with approved credentials; scripts/bundles may be generated earlier in CI. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.dp-migration-fails-visibly EX WF-019 MUST ;; The production migration step fails visibly. ;; = ;; none ;; Visibility requirement not in the oracle.
C pst004.dp-no-prod-seeding OL PST-004,WF-019 MUST_NOT ;; Development seeding never runs in Production. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.dp-ci-cd-separable EX WF-017 MUST ;; Keep CI and CD separable; a green CI build does not mean every branch deploys. ;; = ;; none ;; CI/CD separation not in the oracle.
C sec001.dp-no-secrets-pipeline OL SEC-001,SEC-002 MUST_NOT ;; Use the platform secret or workload-identity mechanism; never real secrets in pipeline YAML, Dockerfiles, committed Compose files or image build arguments. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.dp-env-protection EX - DEFAULT ;; Use environment protection or approvals where the hosting platform supports them. ;; delivery ;; Platform support. ;; Deployment-protection guidance not in the oracle.
C x.dp-verify-pipeline EX WF-003,WF-006 MUST ;; Verify the pipeline restores from a clean environment, builds backend and frontend, runs configured tests, does not depend on developer-machine state, exposes no secrets and produces expected artifacts; for container changes build the image, start the app and check port/configuration, non-root execution and health-probe integration. ;; = ;; none ;; Pipeline-verification checklist not in the oracle.
C x.dp-output EX WF-009 MUST ;; Report files changed, stages and their commands, what was verified and unconfirmed hosting assumptions. ;; = ;; none ;; Workflow output contract not in the oracle.

C x.di-registration-shape EX ARC-021,ARC-023,GOV-012 PREFER ;; Interface-to-implementation registration at architectural boundaries, concrete registration for implementation-only helpers; prefer explicit registration in small and medium applications; keyed services, factories, decorators and scanning only for actual composition problems. ;; = ;; none ;; Registration-shape guidance not in the oracle.
C x.di-keyed-when EX GOV-012 DEFAULT ;; Keyed services for several implementations of one abstraction selected by a known key, not when a single registration or simple factory is clearer. ;; = ;; none ;; Keyed-service guidance not in the oracle.
C x.di-scrutor-not-for-single EX DEP-001,GOV-013 MUST_NOT ;; Scrutor is not added for a single decoration when normal composition is simpler. ;; = ;; none ;; Concrete package guidance not in the oracle.
C x.di-scanning-when EX GOV-012,ARC-023 DEFAULT ;; Use assembly scanning only when registration volume creates genuine repetitive boilerplate, scanning the assembly that owns the services. ;; = ;; none ;; Scanning guidance not in the oracle.
C arc022.di-captive-scope OL ARC-022,ARC-007 MUST ;; A singleton or hosted service needing scoped work creates a scope per operation and resolves a scoped orchestration service, not Infrastructure internals. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc022.di-scoped-app-service OL ARC-022 MUST ;; An application service depending on scoped repositories or the Unit of Work is scoped; registering it as a singleton captures them. ;; = ;; none ;;

C gov002.dw-read-spec OL GOV-002,GOV-008 MUST ;; For a new application or substantial feature read SPECIFICATION.md before planning or implementing, and CUSTOM_SETTINGS.md when it holds values. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov018.dw-check-request OL GOV-018,GOV-004,GOV-006,GOV-010 MUST ;; Check the request against the challenge obligation and the product-source rules (gaps, string semantics, tunable values) before planning. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov017.dw-classify OL GOV-017 MUST ;; Classify every decision the plan needs as Decided, Delegated or Reserved; raise a Decision Request for Reserved ones and use architecture-decision after approval. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf001.dw-inspect OL WF-001 MUST ;; Inspect the relevant existing code (code changed, callers, contracts, tests, conventions) before any non-trivial change and apply the standards and knowledge for the touched areas. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf001.dw-read-standards OL WF-001 MUST ;; When planning before files are opened, read the standards for the scopes that will change. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf001.dw-load-knowledge OL WF-001 MUST ;; Load the knowledge skill for each technology involved. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov014.dw-scope OL GOV-014 MUST ;; Stay within the requested scope. ;; = ;; none ;;
C tst009.dw-regression OL TST-009 DEFAULT ;; For a meaningful bug with plausible recurrence add a regression test that fails before and passes after the fix unless equivalent coverage exists. ;; = ;; Equivalent coverage exists. ;;
C pst008.dw-seeder OL PST-008,PST-001,PST-006 MUST ;; Domain/persistence changes affecting seeded entities (required/removed/renamed properties, relationships, required related entities, enum/status values, states, invariants) update the development seeder in the same change; a recreated empty Development database must yield valid representative data; the seeder does not patch already-seeded rows. ;; = ;; none ;;
C pst010.dw-migration-review OL PST-010 MUST ;; Treat EF Core migrations as source code and review every generated migration before committing (destructive changes, column recreation, data migrations, indexes, foreign keys, delete behaviour). ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.dw-review-seeder-with-migration EX PST-008,PST-010 MUST ;; Review the seeder together with any migration that affects seeded entities. ;; = ;; none ;; Joint-review step not in the oracle.
C run012.dw-perf OL RUN-012 MUST ;; Performance-motivated change: identify the bottleneck, preserve behaviour, use the simplest effective optimization, add/maintain tests, benchmark or profile non-obvious or complex optimizations. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api014.dw-classify-breaking OL API-014 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; Classify public API contract changes as compatible or breaking; a breaking change to a relied-on contract follows the versioning rule and is Reserved. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api022.dw-deprecation OL API-022 MUST ;; Deprecating an externally consumed version: mark it in versioning metadata, document the replacement, communicate a realistic migration/removal timeline, keep it working for the promised support period; never remove it without considering the support contract. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf002.dw-code-review OL WF-002 MUST ;; For substantial feature work or a new application run code-review (agent code-reviewer) before final verification. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf003.dw-verify OL WF-003 MUST ;; Before declaring implementation complete run verify with checks appropriate to scope and risk. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.dw-output EX WF-009,GOV-017 MUST ;; Report what changed and why, Delegated decisions taken, Decision Requests raised or unresolved, and the verification report. ;; = ;; none ;; Workflow output contract (Delegated decisions reporting) not in the oracle.
